title: Download cradles — DownloadString|iex, Invoke-WebRequest, BITS
objective: Audit three download-cradle transports (the classic iex+DownloadString from L3.5, an Invoke-WebRequest pivot, and Start-BitsTransfer), distinguish fileless in-memory execution from BITS's disk-dropping background transfer, and name each transport's ATT&CK ID and primary detection artifact.
